title: e7m-sim scene.yaml schema
description: Schema for 70-tools/e7m-sim/scenes/<name>/scene.yaml. Validates the existing cartpole/kusawake convention (per ADR-2605261800 R1.1) plus the `world:` section added by ADR-2605262500 §3 for outdoor robotics sim. Permissive on sections that haven't yet been canonicalized (additionalProperties: true).

adr.description: Authoritative ADR for this scene (e.g. ADR-2605261800 for cartpole; ADR-2605262500 for wadachi-r1-shibuya-1km).

sim_consumer.description: Robot/task identifier this scene targets, e.g. 'wadachi-r1', 'kusawake-r1'.

nv_compat_target.description: Optional nv-compat facade target class (ADR-2605261800 §4), e.g. 'isaacsim.core.api.World'.

world.description: Geospatial world-data composition (ADR-2605262500 §3). Maps datasetPin CIDs into per-layer USD primitives. PRESENT only on outdoor scenes; absent on cartpole/kusawake.

bbox.description: Spatial bbox as [west, south, east, north] in `crs` units.

output_subdataset.description: Path under 90-docs/baien/datasets/ where the assembled USD scene CID is pinned.

layers.description: Ordered list of world-data layers. Order matters for shader/material stacking.

props.description: Optional object-instance props placed on the world (e.g. parked cars). Tier-C-tagged props force the scene's max_tier to C and require `-nc-` infix in the scene name (G4 + G5 of ADR-2605262500).

scene.description: Genesis-physics scene-level config (matches ADR-2605261800 R1.1 cartpole convention).

quality_gate.description: G5 (ADR-2605261600) / G11 (ADR-2605262500) quality target vs Isaac Sim reference scene.

charter.description: ADR-2605262500 charter compliance assertions per scene.

max_tier.description: Maximum tier across all layers + props. Used by assemble-usd-scene.py to enforce `-nc-` infix on Tier-C (G4).

charter_rider_scan.description: G1 — must be 'required' for any scene that ingests external CIDs.

pii_filter.description: G2 — 'required' when any layer references Mapillary (vision PII applies).

replication_min.description: G3 — minimum IPFS replication for source subdatasets.

physics_backend.description: G7 — PhysX N1..N9 NEVER per ADR-2605261800 §2(b).

render_backend.description: G8 — OptiX / RTX Renderer / Replicator NEVER.

budget.description: G12 — Murakumo capacity caps per ADR-2605261600.

kind.description: ADR-2605262500 §3 layer kinds. Each maps to a per-kind dispatch in assemble-usd-scene.py §4.

datasetPin_at.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.substrate.datasetPin receipt. Placeholder `<rkey-placeholder>` is permitted at W1 path-reserved stage.

tier.description: Charter Rider license tier per ADR-2605262500 §2. Tier C forces G4 (`-nc-` infix on derived sim recordings).

kind.description: Prop kinds. Object instances = static rigid (cars, signs); skinned humanoid = pedestrian rigs (W4+, requires PII vetting).

placement_strategy.description: Free-form strategy slug (e.g. 'road_lane_center_jitter'). assemble-usd-scene.py looks up the implementation.
